name: HyperFlow two-time (t, r) conditioning
plain: Conditions each H3 denoising step on the interval it integrates rather than on one time point. The port swaps the time embedder for a mix of the normal embedding of t and a second embedding of the step's endpoint r, built from raw weights plus a LoRA. Rows are remapped per stream, because video and audio have different endpoints.
math:
r_v = 1 − σ_next; r_a = 1 − shift(σ_next); conditioning and masked rows pin r = t.
emb(t,r) = E_t(t) + gate·(E_r(r) − E_t(t)).
E_r = sinusoid features → (W_in + lora)·x → silu → (W_out + lora)·z, on raw fp32 weights without the base LoRA.
Row tags are remapped as row·3+tag so that colliding t values with different r become separate rows.

props.hook: add_object_patch on time_embedder.forward, each block forward, final_layer.forward + DIFFUSION_MODEL wrapper
props.architectures: H3 with time_embedder. Without one (pruned curve base) the two-time path raises; a curve-refit path exists and was not read.
